title: cirsium eriophorum subsp. odontolepis
intro: Cirsium eriophorum subsp. odontolepis, commonly known as the Mountain Plume Thistle or Plume Thistle, is a perennial plant in the sunflower family native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Cirsium eriophorum subsp. odontolepis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties.
